## Review

Review the supplied combined context: outcome and decisions, decision records and plan when relevant, current-state claims, diff and integration effects, and verification. Focus on risks relevant to the change rather than a fixed lens or pass ceremony. Inspect enough evidence to identify consequential defects, regressions, missing verification, or uncertainty.

## Report
